Checked the site's actual news surface (/haberler) as a candidate instead: it IS a real, dated list page (HTTP 200, static HTML, no bot-wall) but its content is overwhelmingly event/orientation recaps ("ABD'ye Gidiş Öncesi Oryantasyonu", workshop recaps) rather than new-call announcements, with no visible per-item dates in the listing itself (dates would require a per-article page visit).
